name: SEIS workspace operations layer
principle: Integrations are operating surfaces; repository records stay the source of truth.

docs.seis_record_rule: Every Drive operating doc keeps a counterpart record or link in docs/platform.

backlog.seis_record_rule: roadmap/seis-closed-code-backlog.md is the source of truth; the Sheet mirrors it.

calendar.seis_record_rule: Build review outcomes land in the backlog Done section or a decision record.

mail.seis_record_rule: Mail becomes an operating lane only after a durable artifact (label/filter scheme) is registered here.

team_updates.seis_record_rule: Team update channels are registered here before any automation posts to them.

sync_rule: Update this file and integrations/google-workspace.json together; check:workspace-operations guards artifact references.
